_meta.source: The Useful Life of a Bubble, Section 10.4 (25 July 2026)
_meta.rule: Read the refutation column first. If a refuting condition is met and you reach for a reason it does not count, the thesis has become a belief. (Sec 10.7)
_meta.check_types: fred = auto-checkable daily; fred_spread = derived from two FRED series; manual = requires reading a filing or release on the event date
_meta.baseline_note: Report's own July 2026 read: periphery repricing already underway (ORCL 5y CDS 203bp vs IG index 79bp; CCC/HY dispersion 3.58x).
_meta.states: Manual tripwires may carry state ('confirm'|'refute'|'quiet'), state_as_of, state_note — set on event days via the set_tripwire_state MCP tool. Missing state = not yet assessed (treated as quiet).
_meta.sessions_note: For dials declaring 'sessions', BOTH the confirm rule and the refute 'sustained' rule are evaluated over that same full session window — an operationalization choice, made visible here per the git-visibility principle.

tripwires.name: CCC minus HY dispersion
tripwires.notes: The single most informative number in the report: IG at post-1998 tights while CCC prices the tail.

tripwires.name: NVIDIA inventory
tripwires.refutes: Inventory grows slower than revenue for 2 quarters

tripwires.name: CoreWeave equity-cure usage after 28 Oct 2026
tripwires.current: Unlimited until 28 Oct 2026; capped at 3 of any 4 consecutive months thereafter; CRR >=0.85x tested monthly since 28 Feb 2026
tripwires.confirms: Any cure exercised, or any covenant shortfall, after 28 Oct 2026
tripwires.notes: The hardest tripwire in the report. Binary and unavoidable.

tripwires.name: CoreWeave backlog to revenue
tripwires.current: $99.4bn vs $8.3bn annualised = ~12x; 36% of RPO converts in 24 months
tripwires.refutes: Ratio falls below 8x via revenue growth

tripwires.name: CoreWeave cash to current debt
tripwires.confirms: <0.25x in a quarter with no completed raise

tripwires.name: CoreWeave marginal cost of capital
tripwires.confirms: Next unsecured >11.00%, or secured wider than SOFR+500

tripwires.name: Meta non-cancelable commitments
tripwires.current: $237.67bn, +$106.6bn in one quarter; $182.88bn of uncommenced leases
tripwires.confirms: Sequential decline (cancellation), or growth while revenue growth <15%

tripwires.name: Big-four capex / operating cash flow
tripwires.confirms: Four-company aggregate >110% for two consecutive quarters
tripwires.notes: Epoch's crossover estimate: aggregate crosses above OCF ~Q3 2026.

tripwires.name: Server useful lives
tripwires.current: Alphabet 6y; Amazon 5-6y; Meta 5.5y; Oracle 6y; Microsoft 2-6y; CoreWeave 6y
tripwires.refutes: Any shortening, as Amazon did in 2025
tripwires.notes: The single most informative disclosure of the next twelve months (Sec 10.7).

tripwires.name: GE Vernova gas backlog + reservations
tripwires.current: 116 GW vs 20 GW/yr output; guided >=125 GW by YE2026; 54% is reservations; Q2: 18 GW new reservations vs 2 GW firm orders
tripwires.confirms: <120 GW at YE2026, or any disclosed slot cancellation
tripwires.notes: Reservation-to-firm-order conversion is the single most important supply-chain number (Sec 8.7).

tripwires.name: Vertiv orders / backlog / book-to-bill
tripwires.current: NOT DISCLOSED in Q1 2026. Last: $15.0bn backlog, +252% orders, 2.9x
tripwires.notes: Companies stop disclosing numbers before those numbers go bad (Sec 10.5).
